svg.title: Robustness under distribution shift
svg.desc: Same ImageNet accuracy, very different robustness: a supervised ResNet-101 collapses on ImageNet-R, ObjectNet, Sketch and ImageNet-A while zero-shot CLIP stays high.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Matched on ImageNet, but zero-shot CLIP is far more robust
